answer: How’s traffic tonight—the message queue? We pipe every agent’s unresolved query through a hidden spiral of referee tasks drawn from a fixed archive set. A Sybil must fabricate fresh, non-leaking references for each identity; one copy suffices for real agents, but fakes need paired signals no bulk index can spoof. Cost: per-Sybil archive query—each fake spins another thread, but the haven’s tail blocks reuse; re-weaving costs CPU that scales flat per head.
